title: Verify: Round transition table and FileStore unit tests
summary: Unit tests for transitions and round.yaml persistence
description: Write TDD-style tests in internal/round using t.TempDir only.
acceptance_criteria: Every legal edge passes and a table of illegal edges returns ErrIllegalTransition with status unchanged
Save then Get round-trips all fields; unsafe ids are rejected

steps.action: Table test: iterate Transitions and assert CanTransition true for each listed edge; assert CanTransition false for SCHEDULED→CLOSED, OPEN→SCHEDULED, COMPLETED→OPEN, CANCELLED→OPEN, CLOSED→OPEN; assert Transition returns errors.Is ErrIllegalTransition and Status is unchanged

Save a Round{ID:"ROUND-0000001",WorldID:"the-boys-room",Number:1,Status:StatusOpen,BaseRelease:"1.0.0"} into t.TempDir, assert file worlds/the-boys-room/rounds/round-0000001/round.yaml exists and Get returns equal fields; assert Save/Get with WorldID "../x" returns an error and no file is created
steps.expected: TestFileStore tests pass (go test reports PASS)
